verses.text: How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!
lines: How lovely are your dwellings,
Yahweh of Armies!

verses.text: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
lines: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh.
My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.text: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.
lines: Yes, the sparrow has found a home,
and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young,
near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

verses.text: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you.
lines: Blessed are those who dwell in your house.
They are always praising you.

verses.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
lines: Blessed are those whose strength is in you,
who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

verses.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.
lines: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs.
Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

verses.text: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
lines: They go from strength to strength.
Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

verses.text: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob.
lines: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer.
Listen, God of Jacob.

verses.text: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.
lines: Behold, God our shield,
look at the face of your anointed.

verses.text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
lines: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand.
I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God,
than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.text: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.
lines: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield.
Yahweh will give grace and glory.
He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

verses.text: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
lines: Yahweh of Armies,
blessed is the man who trusts in you.
